title: Termwise representatives for affine spectrum coefficient transport
statement: Let $X,X\prime$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with chosen derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $K\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $c$ be K-flat Coordinates for this coefficient morphism [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. There exist Coordinates $d$ for the explicitly transported coefficient objects and morphism [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates], whose complexes are exactly $d.P=(X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.P$ and $d.N=(X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1})^*c.N$, with both pullbacks taken termwise. No base-change square or invertibility of a stalk comparison is assumed.

source.place: lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine spectrum reduction; Tag 0D5S, lemma-pullback-composition; Tag 0098, lemma-stalk-pullback

proof.text: Define P0 and N0 by actual termwise inverse-spectrum tensor pullbacks. Pullback preserves K-flatness of P0. The isomorphism-pullback counits are invertible on c.P and c.N. Compose their inverses with the quotient/localization comparison isomorphisms and the derived images of c.e and c.eprime to construct e0 and e0prime.

Construct a by the underived composition comparisons and inverse-spectrum naturality. Set t0=a_P composed with inverse-spectrum pullback of c.t. The representative-map equation gives the represents field for this actual chain map and the canonical e0 and e0prime.
Apply the shared counit_isIso_kFlat theorem from IsomorphismPullbackCounit to P0 and its proved K-flatness. Assemble all fields of Coordinates; the two complex equalities are reflexive.

theorem exists_affineSpectrum_coordinate_representatives
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X']
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (c : Coordinates g' K K' φ) :
    ∃ d : Coordinates (Spec.map g'.appTop)
        (affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K) (affineSpectrumDerivedObject X' K')
        (affineSpectrumDerivedMorphism g' K K' φ),
      d.P = ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.P ∧
      d.N = ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.N
